audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0-3].side all read 'Caitlyn' and phases[4].side reads 'Skill', but content win[0-3]='Sivir' and win[4]='Caitlyn' (matching the packet levelChart exactly: Sivir,Sivir,Sivir,Sivir,Caitlyn,Skill,Sivir). phases[6].side also read 'Skill' vs win[6]='Sivir'. The chart disagreed with itself on who wins levels 1-6 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Content whys[0-3] (Spell Shield blanking her Q, W waveclear starving trap setups) and whys[4] (Ace in the Hole 90s CD + net all-in) already describe the correct sides and match the packet chart; only the full-layer side/rating fields were stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Sivir, phases[4].side -> Caitlyn, phases[6].side -> Sivir, with ratings adjusted and phases[4].why rewritten to match (the existing why text for 0-3 and 6 was already Sivir-favoring and did not need rewriting).

audit.why: Power spikes are named concretely and now agree with the corrected chart: Sivir's early Spell Shield-vs-Peacemaker/shove edge, Caitlyn's level-6 Ace in the Hole (90s CD) + 90-Caliber Net all-in window, an even first-item skill check, and Sivir's late cleave/On The Hunt teamfight spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] (titled 'Spell-shield his engage tool') carried the tradeGood sentence about Q/W-bounce, unrelated to spell-shielding. dontsFull[2] (titled 'Chase kills off your tempo') carried the tradeBad sentence about E on chip damage, unrelated to chasing kills. Both titles also misgendered Caitlyn as 'his'. suspectNames flagged 'Caliber Net' and 'Yordle Snap Traps' but both instances on the page already read the correct names (90-Caliber Net, Yordle Snap Traps) — false positives, no action needed.
audit.why: Sivir's E (24/22.5/21/19.5/18s CD) blocks one targeted cast; Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker (Q) is her main poke and the one worth saving the shield for, per spikes[0].text already on the page. Chasing a kill under Caitlyn's tower costs Sivir's shove/tempo plan and risks a trap-headshot reset.
